title: Transmissão em movimento
caption: Engrenagens evolventes e biela com articulações derivadas da mesma geometria. Estudo local de validação do motor.
before: Duas engrenagens, uma biela e um cursor. Explore como a rotação se transforma em deslocamento, mantendo os dentes engrenados e os pinos conectados.
after: Este estudo foi construído para verificar as novas peças do motor do Leitor. É uma demonstração local revisada, não uma geração aprovada automaticamente pela IA. O modelo descreve cinemática ideal; não calcula forças, desgaste ou fabricação.
css:
.bench{--anatomy-weight:.8px;padding:24px;color:var(--anatomy-strong);background:var(--anatomy-card);border:1px solid var(--anatomy-faint);border-radius:18px;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}.bench-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:11px var(--anatomy-mono);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--anatomy-muted)}#bench-art{margin:16px -12px 4px;overflow:hidden;min-height:150px}.bench-accent{fill:none;stroke:#b38142;stroke-width:2.8;stroke-linecap:round;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}.bench-pitch{fill:none;stroke:#b38142;stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:4 4;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}.bench-readings{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--anatomy-faint)}.bench-readings span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--anatomy-muted);margin-bottom:7px}.bench-readings output{font:20px var(--anatomy-mono);letter-spacing:-.04em}.bench-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}.bench-controls button{border:1px solid var(--anatomy-faint);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 14px;background:transparent;color:var(--anatomy-strong);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;min-height:38px}.bench-controls button:hover,.bench-controls button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--anatomy-shade-1);border-color:var(--anatomy-mid)}.bench-controls button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #b38142;outline-offset:2px}.bench-controls #bench-play{background:var(--anatomy-strong);color:var(--anatomy-card);border-color:transparent}.bench-angle{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;margin:22px 0 8px;color:var(--anatomy-muted)}#bench-angle{width:100%;accent-color:#b38142;cursor:pointer}#bench-status{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--anatomy-text);margin:12px 0}.bench-note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--anatomy-muted);margin:16px 0 0;max-width:58ch}@media(max-width:500px){.bench{--anatomy-weight:.8px;padding:16px 12px}.bench-readings{gap:6px}.bench-readings span{font-size:11px}.bench-readings output{font-size:15px}.bench-controls{gap:5px}.bench-controls button{padding:9px 11px;font-size:12px}.bench-head{font-size:9px}}

html[data-theme=dark] .bench{--anatomy-shade-0:#242421;--anatomy-shade-1:#2a2a27;--anatomy-shade-2:#30302c;--anatomy-shade-3:#383833;--anatomy-top:#353531;--anatomy-paper:#272724;--anatomy-lo:#68685f;--anatomy-mid:#98988c}
